description.value: Purebread is a well-regarded artisan bakery chain with roots in Whistler that has expanded to multiple BC locations including this Mount Pleasant shop. It specialises in freshly baked breads, pastries, pies, and cakes, and has been featured by the New York Times, Lonely Planet, and Vogue. The Mount Pleasant location offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a pleasant urban rest stop for cyclists.
